newsitem.title: USA: Dole endorses chemical weapons pact.
newsitem.headline: Dole endorses chemical weapons pact.

text.p: Former Republican presidential candidate Bob Dole on Wednesday urged Senate approval of a chemical weapons treaty, adding his weight to a White House drive for passage over Republican opposition.

"Is it (the pact) perfect? No, but I believe there are now adequate safeguards," said Dole, the former Senate majority leader who had challenged the treaty as dangerous during last year's presidential campaign. He was speaking at a White House rally led by President Bill Clinton of prominent supporters of the accord. It was being debated in the Senate on Wednesday.
